title: Asha and the wishing star.
lines: On an island in the sea there is a beautiful kingdom.
It's called Rosas.
The houses are white, with red roofs.
There are flowers everywhere.
And in the middle stands a big castle on a hill.
King Magnifico lives in the castle.
He is a sorcerer.
Everyone in Rosas has a wish.
A big dream.
When you turn eighteen, you give your wish to the king.
He keeps all the wishes in his castle.
They float like sparkling bubbles in a big hall.
And once a month the king grants one wish.
Then there's a big party.
A seventeen-year-old girl lives in Rosas.
Her name is Asha.
She has curly hair and she wears a purple dress.
She lives with her mum and her grandpa.
Her grandpa is a hundred years old.
He gave his wish to the king a very long time ago.
His wish is to inspire people with his music.
But his wish still hasn't come true.
Asha really wants to work for the king.
She has a meeting with him.
She asks if he will grant her grandpa's wish.
But the king says no.
And Asha discovers something.
The king hardly ever grants a wish.
He keeps them all for himself.
And people have forgotten their wishes.
They don't remember what they dreamed of anymore.
They feel a little empty.
Asha is angry and sad.
That evening she goes into the forest.
She looks at the stars.
She wishes with all her heart.
I wish everyone could have their wish back!
And then something magical happens.
A star falls from the sky.
Whoooosh!
It lands right next to Asha.
It's a little star.
She's yellow and round, with a happy little face.
She shines and she sparkles.
She can't talk, but she can do lots of things.
Asha calls her Star.
Star sprinkles stardust on everything.
And then the animals and the trees can talk!
Asha also has a little goat.
His name is Valentino.
He wears spotty pyjamas.
When Star sprinkles stardust on him, Valentino starts to talk.
In a very deep, low voice.
Everyone has to laugh.
Asha, Star and Valentino make a plan.
They sneak into the castle.
They want to set the wishes free.
Asha's friends help.
Seven friends, who are each a little bit different.
One who's always sneezing, one who's always tired, one who's always laughing.
But the king sees it.
He becomes furious.
He takes an old, forbidden book of spells.
His eyes turn green.
He becomes an evil sorcerer.
He traps Star in his magic staff.
Asha is desperate.
But then she thinks of something her grandpa always said.
We are all made of stars.
Asha stands in the square.
She calls out to all the people of Rosas.
She tells them the truth.
About their wishes.
And she says: Everyone can wish.
If we wish together, we're stronger than the king!
All the people start to wish.
With all their hearts.
They raise their hands.
And light comes out of their hands.
Starlight!
All that light together is so strong that the king's staff breaks.
Star is free!
And all the wishes float out of the castle.
Like sparkling bubbles.
Every wish flies back to the right person.
Grandpa gets his wish back.
He takes his lute.
He plays the most beautiful song Asha has ever heard.
The king is locked up in his own magic mirror.
And the queen, who is actually very kind, becomes the new leader of Rosas.
Star has to go back to the sky.
But she gives Asha a present.
A magic wand with a little star.
Asha becomes the first fairy godmother.
She helps people make their wishes come true.
And if you see a shooting star tonight, make a wish.
Who knows, maybe it's Star, coming to collect your wish.
The end.
